headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, with Seiya Suzuki leading the Cubs' offense. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns pitching a strong 7.0 innings.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Sebastián Rivero, who has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a left hamate fracture. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion, while Abner Uribe is out with a right forearm flexor strain. Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left wrist tendon inflammation.

The MLB trade market saw several moves, including the Milwaukee Brewers acquiring Jonathan Ornelas from the Athletics for cash. The Baltimore Orioles received Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox, and the Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals were defeated by the Chicago Cubs with a final score of 0-3. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns pitching a strong 7.0 innings, striking out 8 and allowing 0 earned runs. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a double and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the charge at the plate. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, taking the final score 4-3. Randal Grichuk, Andrew Benintendi, Tristan Peters, and Eduardo Valencia all made significant contributions to the White Sox's victory.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with multiple players contributing to the win. Alec Burleson, Joshua Báez, Blaze Jordan, Pedro Ramírez, and Michael Conforto were among the impact hitters, while Michael McGreevy stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Rivero Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added infield depth with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, who was traded to the team from the Athletics for cash.
